Make an Impact as a Forward Deployed Engineer (Finance Focused) at Worldwide
  
  
Help transform how Finance teams work by building AI-powered tools that give analysts valuable time back. In this role, you'll partner closely with finance stakeholders to create practical solutions that accelerate close activities, improve financial analysis, and make financial data easier to access and understand.
  
  
You'll work at the intersection of finance, data, and AI, developing tools that assist with variance commentary, financial planning and analysis, and close processes while maintaining strong governance and compliance standards. Your work will help finance professionals focus on higher-value analysis and decision-making.
  
  
This is an opportunity for someone who combines finance expertise with software engineering skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through modern data and AI technologies.
  
  
Where You'll Work
  
  
This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in US. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build AI-assisted variance commentary and close-checklist solutions that generate draft insights from financial data and identify key business drivers.
* Develop experiences using Databricks Genie and governed finance data to enable analysts to explore information through natural language.
* Partner with FP&A Analysts and Project Financial Analysts to deliver tools that improve efficiency and enhance financial decision-making.
* Measure and report solution adoption, usage, and productivity gains to demonstrate business impact.
* Create assistive reconciliation capabilities that support finance teams while preserving human ownership of controls and approvals.
* Design and deliver AI-enabled applications using Databricks, Python, and modern LLM technologies.
* Ensure solutions align with governance requirements by maintaining clear separation between AI-generated recommendations and financial control activities.
* Collaborate with finance stakeholders to understand processes, close cycles, planning activities, and reporting needs.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks and building data-driven solutions.
* 2+ years of LLM application engineering experience, including prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation.
* 2+ years of experience using Python and sufficient full-stack development skills to deliver production-ready applications.
* 2+ years of experience working within or closely alongside Finance teams, with knowledge of FP&A processes, monthly close activities, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and revenue recognition fundamentals.
* Experience working with finance systems and governed financial data, including platforms such as NetSuite, Certinia, and Workday Adaptive Planning.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Copilot, MLflow, Databricks Vector Search, Databricks Genie, Genie Code, and/or GenieOne; CRO or pharma-services experience and SOX exposure are preferred.
* Proficiency in English

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
  
  
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
  
  
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
  
  
We’re looking for an outstanding engineering to join our Engine Scalability team. The Engine Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.
  
  
We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.
  
  
**You Will**

* Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
* Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
* Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
* Drive projects end-to-end, collaborate with other engineers, and contribute to maintaining strong technical quality and code health on the team.

**You Have**

* Experience: 3+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
* Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
* Real-time Performance Mindset: Experience diagnosing tradeoffs among CPU/GPU time, memory, loading latency, visual quality, and frame-time stability on constrained platforms such as mobile or console.
* Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building production systems involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D asset pipelines, or GPU/client performance. Not required, but a major plus.
* Ownership in Ambiguity: A track record of driving work end-to-end when the problem wasn't fully specified: defining the approach yourself, seeing it through implementation, rollout, and production consequences; gathering more information when requirements didn't make sense.
* Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively across teams (Engine, Rendering, Avatar, Studio, and developer-facing teams) and explain complex technical topics clearly to different audiences.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
  
  
We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Netflix Ads Signal Acquisition: CAPI & Audience Onboarding team plays a critical role in collecting signals for member understanding, measurement and outcome optimization.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Software Engineer on the Ads Signal Acquisition: CAPI & Audience Onboarding team, you will be instrumental in designing and developing Netflix Conversion APIs. These APIs are essential for powering critical Measurement, Optimization, Retargeting and Reporting capabilities.
  
  
As a Software Engineer on the Conversions & Audience Onboarding team, you will develop client-side SDKs for capturing consented advertiser signals across their digital properties, build interfaces that allow advertisers to upload offline conversion data, and architect high-volume, low-latency ingestion APIs. You will develop state of the art JavaScript capabilities to capture key user interactions—from Page Views and Product Discovery to down-funnel actions like Add to Cart, Checkout, and Purchase—while rigorously upholding privacy regulations and user consent preferences. Additionally, you will engineer scalable APIs to process these high-throughput conversion signals. You will collaborate with a team of talented professionals who are deeply passionate about ads technology and privacy, fostering a culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Must Haves**

* Deep knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, including asynchronous patterns and performance optimization.
* Proficiency in software development languages such as Java, Scala or Python.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
* Ability to design and architect scalable, high-performance systems.
* Proven track record in developing, deploying, and maintaining advertising pixels, SDKs, or tag management systems.
* Familiarity with Consent Management Platforms (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc) and their APIs.
* Experience with leading tag management systems such as Google Tag Manager (GTM), Tealium iQ, Adobe Launch, or Segment.
* Deep understanding of browser environments (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox), browser APIs, and common limitations for client-side scripts.
* Strong grasp of JavaScript security threats and mitigation strategies.
* Experience with database systems, both SQL and NoSQL (e.g., MySQL, Cassandra, MongoDB).
* Understanding of big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark & experience working with streaming technologies like Kafka & Flink
* Understanding of distributed systems and cloud computing platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Understanding of data privacy and security best practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and resolve issues efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
* Experience in leading technical discussions and driving decisions.
* Ability to think creatively and propose innovative solutions.

**Nice To Haves**

* Familiarity with clean rooms and industry-leading privacy-enhancing technology for multi-party data sharing.
* Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
  
  
We are hiring a
**System Software Engineer for GCC/LLVM compiler, tooling, and ecosystem**
We are building a team to focus on the modern C and C++ programming language and their ecosystem on Ubuntu. They will deliver the best possible GCC and LLVM runtimes, developer experience and supporting tooling in Ubuntu. They will ensure that the cutting edge of modern programming languages innovation is available to Ubuntu users, to lay the foundation for future inventions and open source communities.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer with a strong passion for compilers, runtimes and tool chains. You will have excellent competencies in modern C/C++, Linux distributions, software architectures and open source software. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in open source technology at Canonical, a growing international software company and make Ubuntu the best operating system to develop and run C/C++ applications in the cloud, in datacenters, in containers, directly on the operating system, and anywhere Ubuntu can run.
  
  
The Ubuntu Foundations Team delivers the core Ubuntu system, the base for the entire Ubuntu family of products and services. Ubuntu strives to deliver the latest-best free software components, in an easy to use and highly reliable form. We build on the technical excellence of keystone open source software like GNU and Debian and bring additional focus and shape to the solutions we offer the industry.
  
  
Part of the Ubuntu Foundations team, you will work on one of the most critical toolchains involved in the making of Ubuntu and the pillars of the modern software ecosystem. You will leverage your competencies and experience in C, C++ to make Ubuntu the best platform to develop, distribute and consume software built with GCC and LLVM. You will be passionate about the future of C, C++, of Ubuntu, mindful of the dynamics of the open-source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large but innovative organizations. You will drive the best in class integration in Ubuntu from desktop to cloud in a secure, reliable, performing, efficient and future-proof fashion.
  
  
You will be discussing design with other team members , mentor less senior engineers, and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu. Your role as part of the Ubuntu Foundations team will have an impact on every aspect of Ubuntu from Desktop, Server, Ubuntu Core and also cloud images.
  
  
***Location:**
This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region*
**The role entails**
Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:
  
  

* Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
* Select, integrate and package best-of-breed tooling with Ubuntu to improve developer and operator experience with GCC and LLVM
* Write high-quality code to create new features
* Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
* Review code produced by other engineers
* Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
* Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events

**What We Are Looking For In You**

* You have relevant GCC or LLVM experience, ideally in the world of cloud-native software and Linux
* You have experience in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
* You are a long-time Linux user
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
* You love technology and working with brilliant people
* You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
* You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
* Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

**Nice-to-have Skills**

* Experience with Linux distributions and distribution engineering
* Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms
* Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
* Performance or Security Engineering experience

**What We Offer You**
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
**Canonical is an equal opportunity employer**
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
